warnings: ANTsPy repository clone may require significant bandwidth and time
Python venv with scientific packages will add ~800MB to image size
notes: Dockerfile.final is ready for Buildah validation. The image uses pre-built antspyx wheel from PyPI (version 0.6.3) to avoid complex C++ compilation. The eval.sh and test assets are intentionally excluded from the image as runtime-mounted verifier assets. The /workspace directory is materialized by repo_setup.sh during build, not copied from build context.
